crossRefs.note: Then the king said to Ziba, “Behold, all that belongs to Mephibosheth is yours.” Ziba said, “I bow down. Let me find…
The king said to him, “Why do you speak any more of your matters? I say, you and Ziba divide the land.”
Now there was a man of Benjamin, whose name was Kish, the son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Becorath, the son…
But the noble devises noble things; and he will continue in noble things.

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

people.name: Ziba
people.line: Servant of Saul's household, later served David

translations.web: Then the king called to Ziba, Saul’s servant, and said to him, “All that belonged to Saul and to all his house I have given to your master’s son.
translations.bsb: Then the king summoned Saul’s servant Ziba and said to him, “I have given to your master’s grandson all that belonged to Saul and to all his house.
translations.kjv: Then the king called to Ziba, Saul's servant, and said unto him, I have given unto thy master's son all that pertained to Saul and to all his house.
translations.asv: Then the king called to Ziba, Saul's servant, and said unto him, All that pertained to Saul and to all his house have I given unto thy master's son.
